steps.text: Andante tries his best to stop the tide of people approaching Hibiscus, but what a single person can do is limited.
The crowd quickly passes by Andante and surrounds Hibiscus.

steps.name: Drunken Infected
steps.text: Don't make me repeat myself – outta my way!

steps.name: Andante
steps.text: What are you people trying to do?! She's here to help you, so why are you doing this?!

steps.name: Suspicious Infected
steps.text: This has nothing to do with you, Andante! If you're gonna protect this devil, then get her outta the Afterglow!

steps.name: Kreide
steps.text: What——

steps.name: Kreide
steps.text: What's going on here?

steps.name: Andante
steps.text: Kreide? Hibiscus is in there... They're mobbing her!

steps.name: Kreide
steps.text: Move, out of the way! Let me inside!!

steps.name: Drunken Infected
steps.text: Huh? What hole did you crawl out of?

steps.name: Drunken Infected
steps.text: Oh, I remember now. You're the kid who drifted into the Afterglow not too long ago, right? Be a nice lad and go back to taking care of your opa, and don't stick your nose where it doesn't belong!

steps.name: Kreide
steps.text: Hibiscus only came here to help all of you! Why are you treating her like this?

steps.name: Drunken Infected
steps.text: People like you will never understand. We're protecting our homes from the devils, so get lost!

steps.name: Kreide
steps.text: Hibiscus isn't like that!

steps.name: Kreide
steps.text: All I know is that Hibiscus is here to treat Oripathy, and she's whole-heartedly devoted to it. Can't you all see that?

steps.name: Suspicious Infected
steps.text: Treat Oripathy? Whose Oripathy is she here to treat?

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: Kreide, you don't need to get involved with this! This is Vyseheim after all, they wouldn't dare––

steps.name: Drunken Infected
steps.text: Wouldn't dare what?!

steps.name: Kreide
steps.text: The cello?!

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: Are you out of your mind?!

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: If you've got a problem, come at me! What are you flinging Arts at him for? What's any of this got to do with him?!

steps.name: Drunken Infected
steps.text: I... I wasn't trying to––

steps.name: Suspicious Infected
steps.text: Why the hell do we have to answer to you? Get outta here, or we're gonna put a hole in your body just like we did with this cello here!

steps.name: Suspicious Infected
steps.text: Someone's playing the flute?

steps.name: Suspicious Infected
steps.text: Who wants a piece of us next, huh? Show yourself!

steps.name: Meddlesome Infected
steps.text: My... My heart won't stop pounding...

steps.name: Suspicious Infected
steps.text: Scheiße, why'd he have to show up here...?

steps.name: Drunken Infected
steps.text: Hey, where are all you people going? Why are you...?

steps.name: Meddlesome Infected
steps.text: Did you not hear that sound?

steps.name: Drunken Infected
steps.text: Wait... Could it be? Don't tell me it's––

steps.name: Drunken Infected
steps.text: P-Please have mercy on me, I–– I just had a bit too much to drink. I absolutely meant you no disrespect...

steps.name: Drunken Infected
steps.text: ––What in the world am I doing?!

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: The crowd...

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: They were gone?

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: Kreide, are you alright? You're not hurt, are you?

steps.name: Kreide
steps.text: I'm fine, but my cello...

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: Oh no... The body's been damaged so badly. Can it be fixed?

steps.name: Kreide
steps.text: I don't know...

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: Thanks for coming to my aid.

steps.name: Ebenholz
steps.text: Don't mention it.

steps.name: Ebenholz
steps.text: It's a pleasure to meet you–– Or perhaps, 'meet' wouldn't be the right word. However, I haven't had a chance to say hello until now.

steps.name: Ebenholz
steps.text: To be honest, you were in quite a bit of danger back there. Even though the Afterglow is technically part of Vyseheim, your average patrolman has no desire to come around here.

steps.name: Ebenholz
steps.text: If they really decided to attack you, there's a good chance nobody would've come to help you for a while.

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: Then I must thank you again. And to whom do I owe the pleasure?

steps.name: Ebenholz
steps.text: Just call me Ebenholz.

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: Then, Ebenholz, have you heard of the prophecy they were talking about?

steps.name: Ebenholz
steps.text: Not even once. Just caught wind of it from the crowd here.

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: In other words, this prophecy hasn't reached the Cliffy Patio at all...

steps.name: Ebenholz
steps.text: The Cliffy Patio?

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: That's where all the nobles in Vyseheim live, right?

steps.name: Ebenholz
steps.text: Don't lump me in with the lot of them.

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: Huh? But aren't you Vyseheim's...?

steps.name: Ebenholz
steps.text: I'm actually not a native of Vyseheim.

steps.name: Ebenholz
steps.text: Besides, it's discourteous to casually speculate about a noble's identity.

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: Then did you come all the way into the Afterglow to perform in Mr. Czerny's concert? Are you also an Infected?

steps.name: Ebenholz
steps.text: Sorry, but I don't have Oripathy.

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: But I heard from someone that only Infected are performing––

steps.name: Ebenholz
steps.text: That's enough chit-chat for now.

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: Are you in a hurry?

steps.name: Ebenholz
steps.text: Of course I am.

steps.name: Ebenholz
steps.text: Kreide and I were going to Herr Czerny's house to have him assess our practice today, but then all this broke out.

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: Sorry for wasting your time.

steps.name: Hibiscus
steps.text: I'll be heading back to the office now.

steps.name: Ebenholz
steps.text: Alright, don't start moping on me. Let's head to Mr. Czerny's first. I'm sure he'll find you a new instrument, seeing as how he's so fond of you.

steps.name: Kreide
steps.text: Hey...

steps.name: Ebenholz
steps.text: Come, I was only joking around.

steps.name: Kreide
steps.text: Don't worry about it.

steps.name: Ebenholz
steps.text: But that sure is strange. I haven't heard about 'His Majesty's Prophecy' or anything of the sort.

steps.name: Ebenholz
steps.text: (Could it have been Gertrude?)

steps.name: Kreide
steps.text: I think I've heard something along those lines before... But only very vaguely, and there never was any mention of Sarkaz.

steps.name: Ebenholz
steps.text: Well, whatever. The concert is the only thing that matters.

steps.name: Ebenholz
steps.text: What a quaint group of people though. If they really care so much, they should head to the door of the Empresses' Voice and start hollering 'His Majesty, His Majesty.' Now that would be a fun show.

steps.name: Ebenholz
steps.text: But, let's set that aside for now and head to Mr. Czerny's place.

steps.name: Kreide
steps.text: But, my cello...

steps.name: Ebenholz
steps.text: I already told you, Mr. Czerny will get a new one for you.

steps.name: Ebenholz
steps.text: Besides, it's not your fault. Even if Mr. Czerny wanted you to pay him back for that cello, you've still got me.

steps.name: Kreide
steps.text: Right.

steps.name: Czerny
steps.text: The cello is broken?

steps.name: Czerny
steps.text: What, did the two of you decide to jump into a fight?!

steps.name: Ebenholz
steps.text: No, that's not what happened–

steps.name: Czerny
steps.text: Then what happened, Kreide?

steps.name: Kreide
steps.text: Ebenholz and I ran into Hibiscus while we were on our way here.

steps.name: Czerny
steps.text: Hibiscus?

steps.name: Kreide
steps.text: She was surrounded, attacked by a group of people, calling her a devil and saying that she'd bring disaster to the Afterglow.

steps.name: Czerny
steps.text: What nonsense.

steps.name: Kreide
steps.text: I was trying to defend her, and... the cello got blasted by somebody's Arts.

steps.name: Czerny
steps.text: Casting Arts out in the open streets? What's going on in peoples' heads these days?

steps.name: Czerny
steps.text: And so you managed to beat them back?

steps.name: Kreide
steps.text: No, Ebenholz dispersed them with his Arts, and helped get me and Hibiscus out.

steps.name: Czerny
steps.text: He helped you?

steps.name: Kreide
steps.text: Yes.

steps.name: Czerny
steps.text: Alright, I have a clear picture now.

steps.name: Czerny
steps.text: This poor cello... Alas, it was the only decent one I had.

steps.name: Kreide
steps.text: I'm sorry...

steps.name: Czerny
steps.text: Don't apologize, you didn't do anything wrong. If anything, I should be the one apologizing to you on behalf of the Afterglow for those idiots.

steps.name: Czerny
steps.text: In any case, just put the cello over here. I'll go look around and see if there's anything suitable for you to use.

steps.name: Czerny
steps.text: All that's left is this mass-produced one.

steps.name: Czerny
steps.text: You'll have to make do with it. Now let's hear how much you've progressed in your practice.

steps.name: Czerny
steps.text: Begin!

steps.name: Ebenholz
steps.text: Herr Czerny... What'd you think of that?

steps.name: Czerny
steps.text: I won't say there was no improvement.

steps.name: Czerny
steps.text: And considering how the two of you have only been practicing for a day, I shouldn't expect too much.

steps.name: Czerny
steps.text: But it doesn't seem that any of the problems from before have been fixed.

steps.name: Ebenholz
steps.text: None of the problems from before have been fixed? How could that be––

steps.name: Czerny
steps.text: You're reacting a lot faster now, Ebenholz, but you're still getting carried away in your own passages as if you're trying to show off. In the end, you still need Kreide to accommodate you.

steps.name: Czerny
steps.text: You're not even familiar with the music yet, so what are you trying to show off for?

steps.name: Czerny
steps.text: And then there are those ornaments. You managed to hit them all, but it's making your breathing completely uneven. What's the point of that?

steps.name: Czerny
steps.text: Kreide, on the other hand, is more solid in comparison. His main problem is insufficient mastery, something that can be solved with more practice.

steps.name: Czerny
steps.text: But at the end of the day, 'Morgen und Abend' is a duet. It is impossible for one person to constantly be accommodating the other.

steps.name: Czerny
steps.text: In all honesty, I would prefer to strike 'Morgen und Abend.'

steps.name: Kreide
steps.text: Herr Czerny...

steps.name: Czerny
steps.text: What is it?

steps.name: Kreide
steps.text: How about this, can we try again with you accompanying Ebenholz on piano?

steps.name: Czerny
steps.text: Are you sure that's a good idea?

steps.name: Czerny
steps.text: I won't be playing around him like you do. Don't blame me if he makes an utter fool of himself.

steps.name: Kreide
steps.text: It'll be fine.

steps.name: Kreide
steps.text: (Whispers) Chipper up. I know you can settle this in one go.

steps.name: Ebenholz
steps.text: (Nods)

steps.name: Czerny
steps.text: Are you ready?

steps.name: Ebenholz
steps.text: (Takes a deep breath)

steps.name: Ebenholz
steps.text: Let's go.

steps.name: Ebenholz
steps.text: ––How's that!

steps.name: Kreide
steps.text: Herr Czerny...

steps.name: Czerny
steps.text: Your braggadocio hasn't changed at all. What do you take your flute for? A tool to help you show off?

steps.name: Czerny
steps.text: However...

steps.name: Czerny
steps.text: I had no intention of matching your rhythm at all, but you more or less managed to stay steady throughout your part.

steps.name: Czerny
steps.text: It's clear to me now that while Kreide IS accommodating you, he's covering for your bad habits rather than for a lack of skill.

steps.name: Czerny
steps.text: While there's still ample room for improvement, you've at least met my minimum threshold.

steps.name: Kreide
steps.text: So that means...

steps.name: Czerny
steps.text: You pass.

steps.name: Kreide
steps.text: Fantastic!

steps.name: Ebenholz
steps.text: (Lets out a long sigh)

steps.name: Czerny
steps.text: I won't pull my punches though. I've already had to lower my standards to rock bottom today.

steps.name: Czerny
steps.text: I may ask you to show me your progress at any time. If you're still playing at this level before the concert, I will not let you step onto that stage. Am I clear?

steps.name: Kreide
steps.text: Rest assured!

steps.name: Czerny
steps.text: Additionally, Kreide, you're playing on a mass-produced instrument right now, and it is only for emergency use. I would still recommend you find something else.

steps.name: Kreide
steps.text: But the one you gave me is...

steps.name: Ebenholz
steps.text: Don't worry, I'll cover you.

steps.name: Czerny
steps.text: Oh?

steps.name: Ebenholz
steps.text: Let's go shopping tomorrow morning. I'll get you the very best.

steps.name: Gullible Infected
steps.text: What is it?

steps.name: Suspicious Infected
steps.text: So I was telling you about His Majesty, right? His Majesty's prophecy!

steps.name: Gullible Infected
steps.text: No foolin'? Tell me more about it while we walk. I'd like to hear it again, in detail...
